examples.english: Mr. Crookes next sketches out the origin of the elements, supported by Mr. Rynold's method of illustrating the periodic table — too complicated to publish here — and finishes as follows.

examples.text: Mr. Crookes vuelve á hacer un esquema del orígen de los elementos, suscitado por el método de Mr. Rynold de ilustrar la clasificacion periódica — demasiado complicada para publicarla aquí — y termina como sigue.
examples.translation: Mr. Crookes next sketches out the origin of the elements, supported by Mr. Rynold's method of illustrating the periodic table — too complicated to publish here — and finishes as follows.

examples.english: These arguments serve to logically explain the variation of properties using the periodic table and the division of the elements into groups.

examples.translation: These arguments serve to logically explain the variation of properties using the periodic table and the division of the elements into groups.

examples.english: Mendeleev's periodic table contained all the elements known up to then, arranged in a table according to the following criteria: […]

examples.text: La clasificación periódica de Mendeleiev contenía todos los elementos conocidos hasta entonces, ordenados en una tabla según los criterios siguientes: […]
examples.translation: Mendeleev's periodic table contained all the elements known up to then, arranged in a table according to the following criteria: […]
